fallen_moon.acoustic_utility: Infrasonic Singing Sands & Cryo-Acoustic Ticking â€” Wind shear over fine basaltic tephra generates natural singing sand low-frequency drones, while micro-thermal contraction of the peridot meteorite generates crystalline rhythmic pulses.
